Plumber FAQ — Manor

Common questions from Manor clients, answered locally.

How fast can you get to Manor?

Average arrival for emergencies is under 60 minutes, and most Manor calls are scheduled the same day. Call the 24/7 line and dispatch will give you an arrival window before you hang up. Newer Manor builds share similar layouts — we keep parts and supplies staged so repeat visits are rare.

Do you charge extra for nights or weekends?

No after-hours surcharge. You pay the flat diagnostic fee, we present a written price, and you approve the work before it starts—any hour of the day. Lone Star Plumbing Co. answers emergency calls across Manor around the clock. Serving every Manor subdivision plus FM 969 corridors.

How much does a plumber cost in Manor?

The flat diagnostic fee for Manor is $59, credited toward the repair. Common jobs are quoted as flat rates—a toilet install is $185+, drain clearing $149+, so there are no hourly surprises.

Do you guarantee your work?

Yes. Repairs carry a 1-year labor warranty and installed parts keep the manufacturer warranty. If a Manor repair fails inside the warranty, we return at no charge.

Can you handle slab leaks in Manor homes?

Yes. We locate slab and hidden leaks with acoustic and thermal equipment, then repair or reroute with minimal concrete cutting—common in homes across Manor.

Should I repair or replace my water heater?

If the tank is over 10 years old and leaking, replacement is usually the smarter call. We show you both numbers for Manor homes and never push the expensive option.

Do I need to be home for the appointment?

For estimates and repairs, yes—someone 18+ should be present. For scheduled maintenance in Manor, a gated entry note or lockbox code works fine.
